strings.en: ...I have to make this attack count...!
Evasion pattern predicted./　You won't escape...!
No one escapes the supersonic fairy...!
This Raptor is a cut above...
I'll make use of the Boxer's mobility...!
With the Gunner's speed, I can catch it.
I'll draw out the Leonysis's potential...!
Battle isn't something for your amusement...!
That's the commander unit... Gathering data.
It's dangerous to leave that one alone...
Even a Raftclans must have an opening...!
If that one pilots a Raftclans too...
So you'll follow Gu-Landon/　even knowing his true intentions.
The black Raftclans... I mustn't get close carelessly.
Karo-Ran,/　things won't go as you planned...!
If we don't stop Gu-Landon soon,/　Gaw-La Furia will...
Gu-Landon... As you are now,/　you have no right to rule the Fury.
I won't let you go any further.
Earth isn't a place for you to line your pockets.
No matter how many times/　you come to Earth...!
Iradoya... I can't underestimate that one.
I have data/　on the Baran-Schneil...!
That's the head of the Golaikunru...?!
I have to get to Rabulpaila quickly...!
The mobility those thrusters produce is...!
The Gyanonia Ogre is acting as a wall...?!
Reggiane... I won't let you have your way.
Using the Cross Gate's power like that...!
I have to stop the Floraga no matter what...!
It may look like that, but...
What do you plan to do with the Kaana types...?!
Debudedabide... I won't let you do as you please.
I have to watch out for Debudedabide's tricks...
So it doesn't care what it controls...?
I should be able to handle it/　like a normal Zovorg machine.
So a fair number of Zovorg machines/　were captured, too.
Even if it's not controlled,/　that thing still harms people...!
It's hard to read what it's thinking, but...
If I destroy its wings, its mobility will drop.
It's using the Lamaris as a fighting force...?
With moves like that... Before it closes in...!
It's different from the Choukijin and Yokijin...
XN-L... A being that denies all life in this world...!
XN-L, we've defeated those/　who called themselves gods before./　You're no exception...!
I have to take out the gun batteries quickly...!
I have to draw the enemy's attention...
Raig-Geios... I can't let my guard down.
A commander unit with the power of a super robot...
If we sink that ship,/　we can cut down the enemy's forces.
That machine... Is it really Zovorg?
Its movements are uneven for a bioroid...
It's probably not a Zovorg machine...!
It moves differently from the others...!
So we can all get out of here...!
A mass-produced Gyanonia... I can't let my guard down.
A mass of negative thoughts... It's dangerous.
I have to wipe out the Lamaris quickly.
Fusing with each other.../　So that's the unknowns' trait...
Kaana Type... I can't take my time.
Will it get out of hand if this drags on...?!
I have to wipe out the Ida Type quickly...!
Ares Geist.../　If I Disrupt it with my speed...!
For the Ares Geist to/　activate the Lamaris...
So Lieutenant Arieil can achieve her goal...!
To stop Dark Brain's revival, too...!
Whatever the Yokijin do, I'll handle it.
I won't let you go any further...!
I won't make it that easy...!
I've mostly figured out your habits.
The same trick won't work again.
I won't let you get away!
Ugh...!/　I can't die and leave/　Giada and Garnet behind...!
This is nothing...!/　Compared to when I was at The School...!
Checking hit locations.../　Damage check... I can still fight...!
Ngh...! I'm not going down yet...!
I can't afford/　to take any more hits...!
It's not over yet.../　I can still recover...!
If you don't give up, you can seize victory.../　That's what I was taught...!
This unit is precious to me...!/　I can't lose it...!
Holding the Gunner's altitude! I won't fall...!
With that power, if they take/　complete control of the Cross Gate too...!
Ugh! Those attacks really are heavy...!
I won't let you through here...!
More power than its spec data...!
The enemy's superior performance is just an excuse...!
Ugh! It gained power as it grew...!
I can't give it even a moment to multiply...!
I can't take another hit from that sword...!
...!? A direct hit...! I got careless...
This much damage is within tolerance...
...It doesn't matter.../　I got your data in exchange.
Ah...!/　I couldn't make full use of the data...?
Ngh...!/　My pattern analysis wasn't fast enough...
Less damage than I predicted...!/　I can still fight.
Ngh...! It actually caught up to a Fairlion?
The AM parts boost its durability too...!
This much damage, even through the new armor...!
Did I misjudge a knight's power...?!
Fu-Ruu... I have to shake her off somehow...!
It's on a whole other level from the Raftclans...!
I have to watch out for that scythe...!
Reggiane... Bold, but her aim is precise...!
Can it keep using the Cross Gate's/　power like that...?!
It fights with no regard for taking hits...!
...Nothing up its sleeve, it seems./　Next time, I'll see through it.
I won't let you do any more,/　Crystal Dragoon...!
I need more Skull Knight data...!
...Beyond combat data, there's nothing/　you can teach me...!
I won't fall behind a Zovorg unit...!
As expected of a Commander's unit...!
I won't let the Fury set the pace...!
The Thorn's movements are hard to read...!
If that thing is allowed to run free...!
So this is the Ares Geist's power now...!
I can't fall behind the Yokijin...!
There's no need to hold back...
Falling for such a basic trick...
...! ...It's not as fragile as it looks.
No anomalies in the W-LINK System...
I'm fine.../　I can't let the princess worry about me.
It didn't reach the Exbein itself.
It seems an Agent's skill falls short of a knight's.
I have to avoid a direct hit from the Emperor Unit...!
Not everything will go as you plan, Gomoudokka.
Reggiane, I have no intention of amusing you.
The Cross Gate's energy conversion/　isn't working properly...?!
What did you do, Crystal Dragoon?
...I should probably put some distance/　between me and XN-L while I can.
With that firepower, this is the limit.
At least this will draw that enemy's attention.
I'll use this result to analyze Gadisword units too.
This won't make me flinch, Fury.
The Thorn... As expected, it's not easy.
It moves faster than it looks...!
I must evade the Kaana Type's attacks without fail...
The Ares Geist is getting faster...!
I couldn't shake off the Yokijin...!
Don't underestimate me/　just because I'm a child.
I'm always updating my evasion patterns.
You can't lay a finger on my Raptor...
It's a small unit. You won't hit it.
Princess Shine gave me this unit./　I can't let it get damaged...
The Fairlion has the edge in speed...
This isn't just any unit./　It's my bond with Princess Shine...
The Gunner can dodge that easily.
I can handle Gadisword units too.
I won't fall for that, So-Des.
I have no intention of playing with you...
Karo-Ran, that's not enough to catch me off guard.
I can't let it stay on top of/　the Cross Gate forever.
XN-L, your very existence is unnecessary.
I have full data on Zovorg units.
I know that unit's attack patterns.
As I thought, it's different from Zovorg units.
If I watch the tip of the blade closely...
Faster than Zovorg mass-produced units, but...
I have the Baran-Schneil's data too.
With its properties unknown, I can't risk contact.
You won't get what you're after.
Don't think you can possess me.
Even the Kaana Type has patterns.
I won't take that power head-on.
It moves like the old Ares Geist...
I'll keep drawing the enemy in...
From that attack, I'll pinpoint the enemy's position.
Arado.../　You didn't put in many evasion patterns.
That's the Falken... It moves well.
Transferring evasion patterns to Type G...
Combat data from the other Raftclans paid off.
You can't lead people by force./　Not even the Fury.
Even attacks like that leave room to dodge.
Gomoudokka... If you're pulling out, now's the time.
Being cautious, it shouldn't press in too deep.
There's no telling it won't try to possess me.
It seems the magic show is over.
Even if it's not human or machine.../　I can read its patterns.
It moves faster than it looks.
You could call that an interesting move...
I have equipment like this too...
I need to be more selective with attacks...
I need to cut down on wasted attacks...
I need to hurry the search...
I'm not fighting just one unit.
I can't get in Ryusei's way...!
Arado.../　Don't get caught in my attacks.
Let me show you/　the New Aggressors' teamwork...!
That's Seolla.../　She's factoring in my moves too...
Seolla's pulled away... My turn to attack.
Princess Shine, I'll take it from here...!
Princess Shine, I'll match your lead.
Major Kai, moving in for backup.
Mai, don't worry about the rest./　I'll handle it...!
Lieutenant Lamia, I'll back you up.
Ing, leave the rest to me.
It's okay, Akemi. I'll follow up.
Sally, leave the rest to me.
Captain, leave the rest to me.
Backing up the Dea Blanche Neige.
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
This is what I can do...!
My machine can still take it...!
I don't want to lose him...!
No matter how tough your body is...!
I don't want to lose any more friends!
Princess Shine, get behind me, quick!
Lieutenant Hugo, leave the rest to me.
Princess Shine,/　I'm taking the controls!
Enemy coordinates confirmed.../　This will do it!
Short range.../　Then the Roll Cannon!
Long range.../　Then the Vostok Laser!
I'll try it like Ryusei does...
Latune, we shall use/　the Royal Heart Breaker!
Princess, single mode for this one!
I leave the rest to you, Latune!
And that is the end of you!
With this unit, I can do/　better than in a Guarlion...!
Data input complete. E Mode, firing...!
Data input complete. B Mode, firing...!
I'll try it... like Ryusei would.
Haaah! Bang bang!/　Bang bang bang! Bang bang bang bang!!
I'll try it like Ryusei would...!
They told me I could handle it now...
Like Ryusei would... I'll try it...!
Take that, and that, and that!!
Take that, and that, and that!
Rapid fire, rapid fire, rapid fire!!
Striking first is basic theory, after all...!
Go easy on the trait overload.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Do my gothic lolita outfit next, okay?!
I might be a little tired after all...
You're a hundred years too early!
I won't give you a chance to escape!
I won't miss a single shot.
